sixsense-pixel: Only the documented t.6sc.co/img.gif external-media collector is contracted. Website enrichment APIs and other 6sense services are separate.
Pixel identity is opaque. Configuration ownership, impression versus click setup, platform support and delivery cannot be established locally.
piwik-pro: Only managed piwik.pro ppms.php collectors are selected. Custom proxy hosts require an explicit custom pack.

Query fields, declared form captures and documented JSON bulk query strings are checked. Raw text query bodies and flat JSON maps receive an explicit information finding; no Matomo PHP coercion is applied.
Product dimensions retain numeric keys through ID 20, including leading zero representations. Optional tuple fields accept null. Unstated price and quantity positivity is not inferred.
Application, goal and custom-dimension configuration, visitor linking and delivery remain external. cdt checks spelling, not calendar validity or server override permissions.
woopra: The documented GET event and identify routes and SDK v11 multipart NDJSON push route are covered on the default and Korean source hosts. Custom domains, third-party proxy paths and other endpoints remain outside this profile.
Enterprise projects can configure additional unique visitor properties. Missing default identifiers produces information, not an assertion that a custom property is unusable.
GET identity and time requirements are documented. SDK push field checks remain advisory. Event, visitor, organization and session custom properties retain arbitrary values.
Identify requests ignore event data. Project ownership, identifier configuration, redirect allowlists and delivery remain external.
yahoo-browser: This pinned ytc.js 1.17.1 producer profile covers exact /sp.pl image and /collect purchase routes. Receiver behavior can differ from this producer. New checks are advisory.
eventData, pixelId and non-email/phone matching identities are forwarded caller values. Their types and monetary limits are not borrowed from the separate Conversions API.
The SDK hashes EMAIL and PHONE into arrays, including retained uppercase prehashes. Account ownership, privacy decisions, delivery and deduplication require external context.
yahoo-dot: Documented /spp.pl requirements are retained. Optional page metadata and auid checks come from the pinned JavaScript producer and remain advisory.
Browser /sp.pl and /collect use a separate pack. Account ownership, enhanced-matching permissions and delivery remain external.
x: Pinned UWT 2.4.12 uses legacy /i/adsct and OneTag /1/i/adsct, plus form POST adsctp variants. Explicit routes replace substring selection.
Nested event objects and legacy event tuples preserve custom properties. Signed revenue spellings emitted by the SDK remain valid. Metadata and hash checks are advisory producer conventions.
Conversions API, account identity, event-code ownership, matching permissions, deduplication and delivery require external context.

engine_change: Generic ndjson encoded-source codec normalizes nonempty JSON lines into independent records and preserves original UTF-8 source byte limits. Later-line syntax failures are never ignored.
review_notes: Sixsense and Piwik PRO fixtures are derived from published contracts, not SDK executions.
No raw SDK source is redistributed. Source hashes and synthetic emitted requests are retained.
Shared registration, directory and NDJSON decoder changes were reviewed before refreshing artifact hashes.
